name: payguard
description: PayGuard — an AI milestone hold for freelance work, built on PayPal Sandbox Orders v2.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w payguard-server" "npm run dev -w payguard-client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w payguard-server && npm run typecheck -w payguard-client
scripts.build: npm run build -w payguard-client && npm run typecheck -w payguard-server
